scope: visible connector and mini-end masks, never an insertion target
model: two independently initialized DINOv2 region heads sharing a frozen encoder

training.loss: per-image class-balanced cross entropy and foreground Dice; mini-end weighted twice

gate.score: minimum of head mask agreement and mean foreground probability, across connector and mini-end
gate.selection: per-camera maximum calibration coverage with zero observed bad accepts and at least 20 accepts; otherwise always abstain
gate.offline_good: both connector and mini-end visible and mask IoU >= 0.75
gate.detail_energy_definition: variance of Laplacian after sigma-1 Gaussian smoothing of mean RGB8; threshold chosen using development images only, not calibrated optical focus

qualification: Independent test risk and coverage, per camera and condition; zero failures on a small synthetic set is not deployment qualification
stress: Black/white camera and severe blur replays, plus invalid/stale/reordered/calibration-mismatched packet tests
limitations: Shared encoder and shared data can cause both heads to agree on mistakes
Gate score is not a calibrated probability
Blur is a digital stress transform, not measured lens defocus
No real images, aperture labels, contact mechanics, tactile input or physical insertion qualification
